schematic.Sticky:
Breakers can be controlled by any Integer Signal (such as the signal BRK here): - 0 is normal closed state - 1 is the tripped or open state
Any logic functions (or a manual switch, or a custom built relay model...) can be used to control the breaker.
The Timed Breaker Logic component simply opens and closes the breaker at user specified times.
When the breaker signal goes from 0 to 1, the breaker will open at the first current zero.

Faults can be controlled by any Integer Signal (such as the signal named Fault here): - 0 is the normal open state - 1 is the faulted or closed state
Any logic functions (or a manual switch, or a custom built model...) can be used to control the fault.
The Timed Fault Logic component simply opens and closes the fault at user specified times.
When the fault signal goes from 0 to 1, the fault will open at the first current zero.
The three phase fault component puts a combination of phase to phase and phase to ground faults to allow any combination of faults to be selected, even during multiple runs!
